chapter: Pianists, radio and cafes of old New Orleans
title: Fuzzy Wuzzy Twins at WSMB radio
summary: Leclerc and Eddie McCarty, as the Fuzzy Wuzzy Twins named by announcer Claude Randall, played on WSMB's opening with the Boswell Sisters.
